scope: Only eight committed incident, protocol, qualification, configuration and source/control-flow evidence files; no raw data or outcomes
remaining_blockers: Responsible scientific owner must explicitly accept or reject residual blinding uncertainty and adequacy of AI review before proceeding.
External human independent review remains required if applicable policy demands it; this AI review does not fulfill that requirement.
New prospective protocol must disclose and accept the deviation before further selection, prediction or unblinding.
All-family admission and rights gates remain; inspected qualification reports unresolved CspA/CI2 item permissions.

original_m17_preserved.other_frozen_criteria: source folds, budgets, seeds, controls and native assay semantics unchanged

tests: Source inspected; not executed by this reviewer

candidate_selection_control_flow.ranking: SHA256 of literal m18:external:SOD1 concatenated with canonical mutant sequence; ascending hex digest; first 96
candidate_selection_control_flow.eligibility: HGVS/reference identity, canonical non-WT single substitutions, initiator-Met exclusion, duplicate sequence rejection and structural input assertions
candidate_selection_control_flow.genotype_identifiers: accession is carried into selected rows; it is not the ranking input
candidate_selection_control_flow.config_consistency: selection_prefix and max_candidates agree with hardcoded source literals, but source does not read these two configuration keys
candidate_selection_control_flow.limits: No candidate output or data was read or recomputed; imported helper implementations outside the bounded scope were not audited; unseen transient historical commands, memory and actual execution remain unproved
